data.title: Leiter Technische Entwicklung (m/w/d)
data.description:
Gesucht wird keine Führungskraft, die Technik nur noch aus Präsentationen kennt, sondern ein Ingenieur, der selbst an Lösungen mitarbeitet. Sie verstehen die Prozesse, führen ein kleines Team und treiben Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit ihm voran. Sie berichten direkt an den Betriebsleiter und übernehmen seine Vertretung. So sitzen Sie nah an den Entscheidungen, ohne den Bezug zur praktischen Ingenieurarbeit zu verlieren.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Teamführung: Sie leiten ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Mechanik, Elektrotechnik und IT und sorgen dafür, dass alle an einem Strang ziehen, auch wenn jede Disziplin eine eigene Vorstellung davon hat, wo das Problem liegt.

  • Anlagen weiterentwickeln: Sie entwickeln bestehende Maschinen und Anlagen technisch weiter und bringen Ihr Wissen in Automatisierungstechnik und SPS-Programmierung selbst ein, nicht nur in der Planung, sondern auch direkt an der Steuerung.

  • Prozesse optimieren: Sie erarbeiten Lösungen für mehr Anlagenverfügbarkeit, höheren Durchsatz, bessere Qualität und weniger Energieverbrauch in den Produktions- und Recyclingprozessen.

  • Projektführung und Investitionen: Sie begleiten technische Investitionsprojekte, Umbauten und die Einführung neuer Technologien.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Sie arbeiten mit externen Maschinenbauern, Dienstleistern und den internationalen Standorten der Gruppe zusammen.

Ihre Qualifikation:

  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium, zum Beispiel Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungs-, Verfahrens- oder Kunststofftechnik, oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung bzw. eine Ausbildung in diesem Bereich.

  • Erfahrung: Mehrere Jahre im industriellen Anlagen- oder Maschinenbau, in der Produktionstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld.

  • SPS: Sie kennen sich mit SPS-Steuerungen aus und programmieren selbst.

  • Führung: Sie haben bereits ein kleineres technisches Team geführt

  • Arbeitsweise: Sie arbeiten praxisnah, gehen technischen Fragen selbst auf den Grund, denken lösungsorientiert und behalten auch in komplexen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Sprachen: Englisch, um sich mit Kollegen an den internationalen Standorten zu verständigen. Perfekt muss es nicht sein.

Arbeitsbedingungen und Gehalt:

  • Gehalt: ca. 70.000 € brutto im Jahr.

  • Arbeitszeit: 37-Stunden-Woche in Tagschicht, ohne reguläre Wochenenddienste.

  • Entscheidungswege: Kurz, in einem eingespielten Team.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Viel Freiheit bei der Weiterentwicklung der eigenen Maschinen und Anlagen.

Ansprechpartner:

Monika Moser

data.title: Strategic Finance Manager (m/f/d)
data.description:
📊 Want to build the finance function of a fast-growing consumer brand from scratch, and sit right next to the founders when the big decisions get made? Then read on. 🐱

At The Better Cat, we are reinventing the pet food market. 🐾 We are a VC-backed startup (backed by FoodLabs, among others) that has become the fastest growing cat food company in Germany and won the Fressnapf Innovation Award in 2024. We sell D2C, on Amazon and increasingly in retail.

This is our first dedicated finance hire, reporting directly to our co-founder Niklas. The role is a real mix: part finance business partner, giving the founding team accurate and timely numbers to decide on, and part hands-on operational finance, building the close and working with our external accountant and tax advisor. We are AI-first and automate wherever we can, so you will have the freedom (and the expectation) to build finance processes the modern way.

Tasks

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own forecasting, budgeting and performance analysis.

  • Analyse revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, costs and working capital.

  • Support pricing, promotion, product mix, channel and product portfolio decisions.

Business Partnering & Decision Support

  • Be the primary finance contact for our Growth & Marketing and Supply Chain teams.

  • Translate financial and operational KPIs into clear insights and actions.

  • Challenge assumptions, connect operational decisions to P&L and cash-flow outcomes, and find opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.

Supply Chain & Working Capital

  • Partner on inventory, procurement, fulfilment, logistics and working capital decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve costs, cash flow and operational efficiency.

Strategic Initiatives & Business Cases

  • Build business cases and quantify the financial impact of major initiatives, such as new brand, channel or country launches, and connect them to financial operations.

  • Support the rollout of controlling processes across the organisation.

Accounting

  • Build the monthly and annual close processes from scratch.

  • Work with our external tax advisor and accountants to ensure robust VAT treatment across countries and channels.

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • 2-4 years of experience in Consulting, Investment Banking, FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Commercial Finance or Strategic Finance.

  • Experience in e-commerce, consumer products, retail, distribution or another physical-product business.

  • At least a bachelor's degree in a relevant subject such as Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business. A professional qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA) in progress or newly completed is a plus.

  • Proven ability to run workstreams independently and deliver high-quality output with minimal supervision.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Experience with accounting software (e.g. DATEV, Lexware) and AI and automation tools (Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Make, Zapier) is a plus. Above all, you are curious about AI and want to use it to work smarter.

  • Comfortable working with large datasets and turning analysis into clear, concise business insights.

  • Solid understanding of financial statements, management accounting principles and business performance metrics.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial mindset and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal communication, including presenting findings to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Proactive and self-motivated, with an entrepreneurial mindset and comfort in a fast-paced, scaling company.

Benefits

  • 🦁 An inspiring team: Ambitious, fun, down-to-earth and authentic. Come and meet us!

  • 🏗️ Build it your way: As our first finance hire, you shape the finance function, its processes and its tools from day one.

  • 📈 Direct access to the founders: You work daily with Niklas and the founding team and help make decisions instead of just reporting on them.

  • 🤖 AI-first environment: We automate wherever it makes sense and give you room to experiment with the latest tools.

  • 🐱 Great products: It is more fun to stand behind something that truly works. Read our reviews or ask us for a sample!

  • 💝 Cool benefits: Deutschland-Ticket, MacBook, Wellpass, merch, office snacks and drinks.

  • ⭐ Great workplace: Modern office in Hamburg's HafenCity, hybrid setup, flexible working hours and fast personal growth.

🐾 Ready to build the finance engine of a scaling consumer brand and make the world a better place for cats?

Then get in touch! 📩 Send us your CV and a short cover letter and tell us why you are the right person for this role. We look forward to hearing from you!

data.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
(Senior) Software Engineer (d/f/m)
data.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you’ll build core features for our flagship product, turning complex tax scenarios into simple, reliable experiences. You’ll bring a builder-first mindset: staying close to customer problems, using AI and modern engineering tools to move from idea to impact quickly, and taking ownership of outcomes—not just code.

You’ll work hands-on in a cross-functional team and bring deep expertise in either frontend or backend engineering, while collaborating effectively across the stack. You’ll help us raise the bar for scalable design, quality, maintainability, and AI-first software development.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Partner with product management, design, and engineering to understand customer problems, shape pragmatic solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Own work end to end—from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Turn ambiguity into action, make sound trade-offs, and deliver valuable increments without compromising long-term maintainability.

  • Contribute to technical direction and strategy in support of the long-term product vision.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Critically evaluate, validate, and troubleshoot AI-generated output, using effective prompting and appropriate safeguards rather than accepting results at face value.

  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices, encourage responsible experimentation, and help teammates improve how they use AI tools.

  • Improve developer experience through tools, automation, and engineering practices that enable reliable, frequent delivery.

  • Collaborate across product and platform teams, and contribute to an environment where people learn, grow, give constructive feedback, and raise challenges safely.

Your profile:

  • Professional software engineering experience (React, Node.js) and designing reliable backend services and APIs. Experience with React Native experience is a plus.

  • Able to work effectively across system boundaries and collaborate with engineers outside your primary specialism.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Able to evaluate and troubleshoot AI-generated output, use effective prompting where relevant, and share practical learnings with teammates.

  • Experience working with a public cloud environment such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts and practices, including CI/CD, observability, and operating software in production.

  • Understanding of core application and backend concepts such as authentication, databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations.

  • A builder-first, pragmatic approach: You turn customer problems into shipped outcomes. You take initiative, test and learn quickly, and make clear trade-offs between speed, quality, maintainability, and risk.

  • Passion for writing maintainable, elegant code and continuously improving how software is built.

  • A collaborative, positive attitude and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively.

  • You have a builder mindset. You thrive in environments where things are still taking shape, take initiative to move ideas forward, and find ways to create impact even when the path isn't fully defined.

  • You embrace trying things out over waiting for perfect conditions, ship early to learn fast, and treat iteration as progress.

 

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

data.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

  • You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

  • Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.

  • You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.

  • You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.

  • You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

#LI-DNI

data.title: Working Student / Intern – Industrialization Land / UGV (m/f/d)
data.description:
As a Working Student or Intern (m/f/d) in the field of Land Systems / UGV Industrialization, you will support our team in Göppingen in establishing serial production for unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). You will work closely with the Industrialization team and our external consulting partners, taking responsibility for clearly defined work packages in documentation, data management, and production planning preparation.

You will collaborate across Production, Engineering, Quality, and Logistics, gaining first-hand experience of a real production ramp-up from the very beginning and seeing how a prototype-based setup evolves into a scalable and repeatable serial production process.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Support the shopfloor planning activities at our Göppingen site by documenting current-state processes and contributing to layout planning, material flow design, and production cycle data (e.g., cycle times, workstation utilization, and walking distances).

  • Support process design activities by helping to structure and document assembly processes for different vehicle variants down to individual work-step level.

  • Create and maintain illustrated work instructions for production processes.

  • Collect, prepare, and analyze process-related data using Excel.

  • Support qualification and training activities by maintaining workstation-specific skill matrices and preparing training materials for assembly teams.

  • Prepare and follow up on workshops and alignment meetings with external consulting partners, including meeting minutes, task tracking, and status reporting.


What you bring to the team:

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Logistics, or a comparable field of study.

  • You are proficient in using Excel and PowerPoint; initial experience with CAD or layout planning tools is a plus.

  • First practical experience in manufacturing, workshop environments, or through academic projects is welcome, but not required.

  • You work accurately and reliably when creating documentation and maintaining data, including recurring tasks.

  • You have a structured and independent way of working and are willing to take ownership of your tasks and follow up on topics proactively.

  • You communicate openly and professionally and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from Production, Engineering, and external partners.

  • You are available to work regularly on-site in Göppingen; the scope and duration of your engagement can be tailored individually.

  • You have good German and English language skills.

  • You have experience using AI tools effectively.

  • You are available to start immediately or by November 1st at the latest.

Why Quantum-Systems:

Wir glauben an die Stärke kombinierter Fähigkeiten: klare technische Expertise gepaart mit einer kundenorientierten Ausrichtung. Wir sind Branchenpioniere, die ehrgeizig, mutig und visionär sind. Wir überschreiten Grenzen, blicken über den Tellerrand und streben nach technologischer Exzellenz, um die Zukunft unbemannter Systeme mitzugestalten. Wir versprechen, dass wir Deine Startbahn für individuelles und berufliches Wachstum sein werden.

Our benefits:

  • Flexible working hours: With our trust-based working time model, you have the flexibility to manage not only your working hours but also your work-life balance independently.

  • Stay active: Through the EGYM Wellpass, you gain access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities, and we subsidize your membership.

  • Corporate Benefits: Take advantage of attractive offers and discounts from well-known brands and providers such as Adidas, Apple, and Expedia.

  • Team Events: We believe in growing together and celebrating our successes as a team.

About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.
